sources.excerpt: Reasoning effort The reasoning.effort parameter guides the model on how much to think when performing a task. Supported values are model-dependent and can include none , minimal , low , medium , high , xhigh , and max . Lower effort favors speed and lower token usage, while at higher effort the model thinks more completely to provide higher quality responses. The models also reason adaptively across reasoning efforts, using fewer tokens for simpler tasks and thinking harder for complex tasks. GPT-6 Astra does not support none reasoning effort. Setting reasoning.effort (Responses) or reasoning_effort (Chat Completions) to none returns HTTP 400
